question: A parallel-plate capacitor with circular plates of radius $R$ has a **uniform** electric field in the gap given by $E(t)=E_0\cos(\omega t)$ (directed perpendicular to the plates). The magnitude of the magnetic field $B(r,t)$ on a circular path of radius $r$ coaxial with the plates (in the gap) is:

options.B: $B=\dfrac{\mu_0\varepsilon_0\omega E_0}{2}\,r\,|\sin(\omega t)|\ (r < R),\ \ B=\dfrac{\mu_0\varepsilon_0\omega E_0}{2}\,\dfrac{R^2}{r}\,|\sin(\omega t)|\ (r>R)$
